subject: [PATCH 2/2] nfsd: back CB_NOTIFY notify_mask words with per-delegation storage

2026-08-12.patch_summary: This patch fixes a problem in the NFSv4 server code where notify_mask words were being stored in host-order format inside an XDR staging buffer, which is meant to hold big-endian data. To fix this, a new array called ncn_masks is allocated alongside the existing ncn_nf array and used to store the notify_mask values. This approach eliminates the need for per-word NULL checks and ensures that only encoded XDR data is stored in the staging stream.
